We are a family of builders, bound by our passion and commitment for the NEAR ecosystem. We help each other build projects that will last for a long time. You will not only enjoy the collective brain power, but also connections, partnerships, and resources within the ecosystem.

Why we want to do this

The future is NEAR. With exceptional usability, scalability, and security, NEAR has become the fastest growing ecosystem. We envision NEAR as a new Layer 1 nation where conventional borders such as laws, taxes, and physical boundaries vanish; the new nation is defined by her values and cultures.

We strive to build on the NEAR culture where passion for decentralization and creativity, and the ambition to build the next game changer, are celebrated and rewarded. You are not just submitting a project; you are joining a highly collaborative, close-knit community of builders and entrepreneurs with an unwavering belief in open source and decentralization.

Building with the community is super fun.

Join us to shape the future of Web3, one project at a time.

Who are NEARFans

NEARFans is created by a group of builders — founders, investors, artists, designers, developers, and product managers who have been in crypto industry since 2012.
We help each other build projects that will last for a long time. You will not only enjoy the collective brain power, but also connections, partnerships, and resources within the ecosystem.
NEARFans governance is driven by decentralized communities.
